title: Best of Singapore, Malaysia and Bali Honeymoon
alt: The Petronas Twin Towers at dusk in Kuala Lumpur
transport: Private transfers, city tours and guided day tours

stops.name: Singapore
stops.subtitle: Singapore to Sentosa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and one main meal daily · Standard room · 3★ · Bencoolen hotel, five minutes on foot from the metro

activities.name: Night Safari with tram ride
activities.description: The world's first nocturnal zoo, with a tram ride through seven habitats and walking trails where the animals are at their most active.

activities.name: Singapore sightseeing tour
activities.description: A half day tour past Merlion Park, the Marina Bay waterfront, Chinatown and the colonial quarter, with a guide on a shared coach.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The observation deck fifty seven floors above Marina Bay, with the whole city, the port and the Gardens by the Bay domes below you.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Entry to the Cloud Forest and Flower Dome, with the Supertree light show in the evening a short walk away.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A full day ticket for the Sentosa theme park, with seven themed zones, the duelling roller coasters and the street shows.

activities.name: Singapore river cruise
activities.description: A bumboat along the river past the old godowns of Clarke Quay and Boat Quay, with the Marina Bay skyline lighting up ahead.

program.name: Singapore
program.description: Three nights in the city with a night safari, the Marina Bay SkyPark, Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios and the river by bumboat.

stops.name: Kuala Lumpur
stops.subtitle: Kuala Lumpur to Genting Highlands
stops.hotel: Hilton Garden Inn Kuala Lumpur - North
stops.hotel_label: Hilton Garden Inn Kuala Lumpur North
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel a short ride from Bukit Bintang

activities.name: Genting Highlands and Batu Caves
activities.description: A private day up to the hill resort by cable car, with the theme park and casino floor, and the Batu Caves temple steps on the way back.

activities.name: Kuala Lumpur sightseeing tour
activities.description: The King's palace gates, the National Monument, Merdeka Square and the old railway station, with a stop for photographs at the towers.

activities.name: Petronas Twin Towers tickets
activities.description: Entry to the sky bridge and the observation deck on the eighty sixth floor, with the city spread out on both sides.

program.name: Kuala Lumpur
program.description: Three nights in the Malaysian capital, with a hill day at Genting and Batu Caves, a city tour and the Petronas towers from the inside.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and one main meal daily · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Uluwatu and Padang Padang beach
activities.description: A half day along the southern cliffs: Padang Padang beach in its limestone cove, then Uluwatu temple as the sun drops into the ocean.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your free day, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa near the hotel.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights in Bali to finish, with a candlelight dinner on arrival, the Uluwatu cliffs at sunset and a spa day before you fly home.

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Three countries in ten days, and the order matters. Cities first, then the hills, then Bali to slow down.
expert.tip: Both inter country hops are short, so take morning flights and you keep the afternoons. We book your Singapore to Kuala Lumpur and Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar legs with the package when you ask.

summary: Ten days across three countries: Singapore for the night safari, Marina Bay and Universal Studios, Kuala Lumpur for Genting, Batu Caves and the Petronas towers, then Bali for a candlelight dinner, Uluwatu at sunset and a spa day.
included: Included: 9 nights with daily breakfast, plus one main meal daily in Singapore and Bali; private airport and city transfers; Night Safari; Singapore sightseeing; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; Gardens by the Bay; Universal Studios; river cruise; Genting and Batu Caves; Kuala Lumpur city tour; Petronas tickets; Uluwatu sunset tour; candlelight dinner; Balinese massage.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Singapore to Kuala Lumpur and Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar flights, which we can add; visa fees; travel insurance; personal expenses.
